    AI Overview
    No, Justin Rose has not won the Masters. Despite a stellar career, he has never won a green jacket, though he has come close with three runner-up finishes (2015, 2017, and a playoff loss in 2025). He is a major champion, having won the 2013 U.S. Open, and won Olympic gold in 2016. 
    This video shows a young Justin Rose finishing fourth at the 1998 Open Championship:
    59s
    The Masters
    YouTube• Apr 6, 2026
    • Best Masters Finishes: 2nd (2015, 2017, 2025), T-3 (2026).
    • Heartbreak: He has been considered one of the best players at Augusta National never to win, often putting himself in contention on Sundays.
    • Other Wins:
      He has won one major title (2013 U.S. Open).
